dataset.attribution: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech, Alexis Conneau and collaborators, Google Research, 2022; distributed by google/fleurs on Hugging Face under CC-BY-4.0.

selection.method: First two Greek cases in the existing development manifest order, fixed by the review task before this new Auto/Small run. Prior development outputs are already exposed; no new inference informed this subset.
selection.purpose: Regression/default-route coverage of omitted model and omitted language form fields through actual upload, automatic Greek detection, SQLite, exports, cleanup and separate-interpreter retrieval.
selection.representativeness: Two previously exposed read-speech clips; not fresh semantic validation, an accuracy estimate or a broad retest.

measurement_notes: Actual upload-to-export elapsed time includes initial model loading and polling; other QA may contend for CPU. This is not a controlled latency benchmark.
WER uses NFKC, casefold, punctuation/symbol deletion and whitespace tokens; a second score removes diacritics. Numeric words versus digits remain different tokens.
Word-edit counts and structural pass do not approve semantic fidelity, proper names, numerical values or negation. Review exact source references and uncorrected hypotheses separately.
Timestamp ordering/range is checked; no independently annotated word-timing reference is available.
Peak RSS is the maximum resident set of this QA process, including loaded model and application. It excludes other processes and is not a whole-machine or combined ASR/translation memory measurement.
Persistence checks query a new SQLite connection and evict in-memory jobs. A separate interpreter checks the final stored records; this is not a full browser/server-restart test.
